loose_01.hue_family: cool blue-cyan with ochre/red line accents
loose_01.composition: all-over, no focal hierarchy; each card a field of marks
loose_01.line_density: high: scribbled pencil/crayon loops, dashes, arcs over washes
loose_01.notes: Gestural scribbles (loops, hatching, dotted dashes) laid over loose blue washes; rain-like vertical dashes in some cards.
flags: composite: 3x3 grid of separate artworks on white
metrics averaged over the nine panels

loose_02.composition: all-over field, darker toward edges, pale centre
loose_02.notes: Pure pigment play: blooms, salt-like speckle, diagonal soft streaks. Reads as water/ice without any form.

loose_03.composition: vertical rhythm of runs from a top band of foliage blobs
loose_03.edge_bleed: high at the top band; runs have hard drip edges
loose_03.drip_density: very high: long vertical drips standing in for trunks
loose_03.notes: Trees suggested only by gravity drips; leaves are dabs. Paper left open between runs. Grey background around the sheet excluded.
flags: photo of a sheet on grey background; ROI crops to the sheet

gathered_01.composition: low horizon, architecture as a thin band with a few verticals, large open sky and water
gathered_01.edge_bleed: soft, forms dissolve into haze; some pencil underdrawing
gathered_01.line_density: low: a few fine pencil lines for masts and windows
gathered_01.notes: Emerging forms: buildings stated by a few warm notes and their reflections; most of the sheet is air and water.
flags: composite: three paintings stacked with white gutters
metrics averaged over the three panels

gathered_02.composition: heavy bottom band of olive dry-brush marks, floating grey shapes above, big white field
gathered_02.edge_bleed: pooled hard edges with dark rims; spatter dots
gathered_02.notes: Semi-abstract landscape: suggests ground, grasses and clouds without depicting them. Dark edge rims from pooling are characteristic.

gathered_03.composition: diagonal light shaft from top-left, dark mass right, path into depth
gathered_03.edge_bleed: very soft wet-in-wet, with sharp spatter and lifted leaf shapes
gathered_03.notes: Atmospheric depth through soft gradients, structure emerging only at the edges (twigs, path).

gathered_04.composition: one-point perspective into depth, vertical drips, light at end
gathered_04.edge_bleed: mixed: dry-brush scumbles and vertical runs
gathered_04.notes: Strong value structure and drips; forms implied by light and dark blocks rather than drawn.

gathered_05.title_observed: breaking surf and sky studies (three views)
gathered_05.composition: horizontal bands: sky, wave crest / cloud streak, beach
gathered_05.focal_area: the white crest or a single blue streak
gathered_05.notes: Few horizontal gestures suggest wave and sky; the third panel is almost colour field with one blue streak.
flags: metrics averaged over the three panels

resolved_01.title_observed: skier on snow slope with conifers
resolved_01.hue_family: cobalt blue and white, small red accent
resolved_01.composition: diagonal slope, long parallel shadows, winding track leading to tiny figure
resolved_01.notes: Graphic, two-value design; whitespace is the snow. Grain texture inside flat shapes.

resolved_02.title_observed: surfer inside a curling wave with a shark
resolved_02.composition: spiral wave occupying the sheet, figure at the eye
resolved_02.edge_bleed: mixed: splashy outer edges, controlled figure
resolved_02.notes: Loose brushwork organised by a strong spiral; detail concentrated at the focal point.

resolved_03.title_observed: white cat peeking from behind a torn edge
resolved_03.composition: vertical split, subject at right edge
resolved_03.notes: Background is pure wet-in-wet blooms; resolution comes from one clearly reserved white subject.

resolved_04.composition: frame-within-frame: car body diagonal, window with drops
resolved_04.drip_density: rain drops as small reserved shapes
resolved_04.notes: Mood through muted value range; detail by many small droplet highlights.

resolved_05.composition: vertical: gate at top, falls in middle, figure at pool bottom
resolved_05.notes: Dappled light reserved as whitespace across rocks; highly resolved illustration.
flags: book cover: Korean/English title text excluded by ROI (top 62% analysed)

resolved_06.composition: diagonal shoreline right, wide reflective flat, tiny figures
resolved_06.notes: Mostly air and reflection; legibility comes from a clear horizon, shoreline and small dark figures.

resolved_07.composition: big cloudy sky, low horizon, figures lower centre with reflections
resolved_07.notes: Wet-sand reflections double the figures; strong whitespace.

resolved_08.composition: diagonal shoreline, boats clustered in a diagonal
resolved_08.notes: Loose ground made legible by a few precisely painted objects.

resolved_09.title_observed: tidal flats with bathers and sparkle
resolved_09.composition: high horizon with dark headland, curving tide channels
resolved_09.notes: Sparkle reserved as white spatter; curved bands lead the eye.

resolved_10.title_observed: winter street, bare trees, lit café
resolved_10.composition: vertical street view, warm lit block bottom left, bare tree lines
resolved_10.notes: Complementary warm/cool contrast; linework (branches) carries the structure.

resolved_11.title_observed: figure in a flowing gown dissolving into mist
resolved_11.composition: single centred silhouette, large empty field
resolved_11.notes: Resolution gradient inside one image: crisp at the focal point, dissolving away from it.

resolved_12.composition: vertical pier top right, boats radiating
resolved_12.notes: Saturated ground with precisely drawn hulls; complementary orange accents.

resolved_13.title_observed: city towers with figures under falling snow
resolved_13.composition: towers rise behind, three figures foreground, lamp post
resolved_13.notes: Atmospheric perspective: towers fade into light; snow as scattered reserved dots.

resolved_14.title_observed: snowy conifer forest above a village
resolved_14.composition: dense repeated conifer cones top, village cluster bottom
resolved_14.notes: Pattern of simple repeated shapes; clarity through repetition and value contrast.
